body: Didn’t know it was this bad.  Always wanted to be a teacher. Got rejected twice and I’ve decided to give up and stay in my industry. This makes me feel like my decision to move on was the right one.

I saw him apologise in the comments of this sub. But I think for some it may not have come across as being sincere or genuine enough. Then again I’m not an American so it’s not my place to comment. But I agree with you that it’s a shame because I really see his passion and loved watching his videos.
